notes.name: Start here
notes.text:
# Start here

This is an example of a works package from the web: a short reading list that the app follows at its address and offers to update when a new version is published.

Error-correcting codes begin with [@hamming1950]. Reed and Solomon's codes [@reed1960] are still in every QR code and disc. Gallager's low-density parity-check codes [@gallager1962] waited thirty years, until turbo codes [@berrou1993] showed how close to Shannon's limit a code could come; polar codes [@arikan2009] were the first proved to reach it.

For a textbook, read [@mackay2003], which is free to read online.
